assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-screen background plate for a 2D first-person Korean apartment horror browser game. Create one polished cinematic hand-painted environment, widescreen 16:9. Camera perfectly frontal, no tilt, no fisheye. Door opening in exact image area x=43% through 76%, y=13% through 88%; left of opening is a solid wall pocket where the sliding panel can hide. Door frame dark weathered brown wood, threshold visible. Moody painterly realistic indie horror artwork with strong readable shapes and detailed materials, restrained cold teal corridor contrasted with a faint warm room spill, sufficiently visible midtones for interactive gameplay, NOT pitch black. No interface, no text, no lettering, no logo, no border, no figures, no generated grain filter, no 3D render aesthetic. Art-directed high-fidelity 2D environment painting, believable ordinary home made uneasy by the empty corridor.
